newsitem.title: JAPAN: Venalum talks in Japan to continue Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: Venalum talks in Japan to continue Wednesday.

text.p: Venezuelan government officials met with members of a Japanese consortium on Tuesday to discuss their dispute regarding the Venalum aluminium refinery, although no solution had yet been reached, a spokesman for the Venezuelan delegation said.
He added that talks will continue on Wenesday and that an announcement may be made Wednesday evening or Thursday morning.
"At the moment we are in negotiations," he said. "There's nothing yet," he added.
Venezuela and the Japanese consortium, which owns 20 percent of Venalum, have been locked in a dispute since the beginning of the year over Japan's veto powers in the venture.
The Venezuelan government said the veto powers will hinder privatisation of Venalum scheduled for late this year.
